items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: the first music that I ever remember playing, I don't know, Victrola, was by Mamie Smith.

ctx.x: Do you remember what was the first band record you ever heard?

Well, now, the first band record, let me see, uh, the first music that I ever remember playing, I don't know, Victrola, was by Mamie Smith. Now, what band that accompanied her, I don't know, because that was a band out east. But, that was the first, uh, uh, band that I, uh, remember. King Oliver with the Diplomouth. Wasn't it the Diplomouth? Mm-hmm. And, uh, Louis played, had a Savoy. Those are some of the early records that I remembered. And, that was in, uh, around 1923 or 1922. Somewhere around in there. I…
I'm sort of jumping around today, but, uh, you say you had piano teachers? Did you have a voice teacher, too?
